title: DIAL Machine Definition
description: Schema for DIAL state machine definitions

machineName.description: Unique identifier for the machine type

goalState.description: The rest state where the session is headed; when reached, no action is needed until something moves it elsewhere

states.description: Record of state names to their configuration

arbiter.description: Default arbiter configuration for all states

prompt.description: Decision prompt for this state. If omitted, a generic default is used.

transitions.description: Map of transition names to target state names

proposers.description: Proposer specialists registered for this state

voters.description: Voter specialists registered for this state

arbiter.description: Arbiter configuration for this state (overrides machine-level)

specialistConfig.description: Configuration for a specialist (proposer or voter)

strategyFn.description: Inline strategy function as a string (Mode 1)

modelId.description: LLM model identifier for LLM-based strategies (Mode 2/3)

webhookTokenName.description: Environment variable name containing the webhook auth token

aheadByK.description: Votes the leading proposal must be ahead by for consensus
